data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Bound the RED window — mark migrated tests in test_differ.py and test_differ_conflict_resolution.py with @pytest.mark.xfail(reason='awaiting task-4/5 implementation', strict=True) so collection passes and the test suite stays green between task-3 and task-5 merges. Remove xfail in task-4 (test_differ.py) and task-5 (test_differ_conflict_resolution.py) respectively. Rationale: preserves bisectability and test-gate integrity during the multi-task migration window (cross_task_interference).
